name: SplunkES_NotableStatusSync
author: Fabien Bloume, StrangeBee
description: Sync TheHive case/alert status back to the corresponding Splunk Enterprise Security notable event(s)

configurationItems.name: host
configurationItems.description: Splunk search head / Enterprise Security host or IP

configurationItems.name: auth_token
configurationItems.description: Splunk authentication token (Bearer). Splunk 7.3+, token auth must be enabled on the instance. The token's roles must grant the ess_analyst role and edit_notable_events capability. Use this or username/password, not both

configurationItems.name: username
configurationItems.description: Splunk username, only if not using an auth token. Must have the ess_analyst role and edit_notable_events capability

configurationItems.name: password
configurationItems.description: Splunk password, only if not using an auth token

configurationItems.name: verify_ssl
configurationItems.description: Verify the Splunk management port's TLS certificate. Disable only for self-signed/lab instances

configurationItems.name: custom_field_name_notable_event_id
configurationItems.description: Recommended: custom field in TheHive containing the Splunk ES notable event ruleUID(s) (format: {UUID}@@notable@@{hash}), comma separated if more than one. Falls back to the native sourceRef field if left empty (or empty on that particular object), but sourceRef only exists on alerts, not cases - set this if the responder will ever run on a thehive:case.

configurationItems.name: status_id_new
configurationItems.description: Splunk ES status ID to set for the TheHive 'New'/'Imported' stage. Status IDs are defined per-instance in reviewstatuses.conf; default matches Splunk ES's factory 'New' status

configurationItems.name: status_id_in_progress
configurationItems.description: Splunk ES status ID to set for the TheHive 'InProgress' stage. Default matches Splunk ES's factory 'In Progress' status

configurationItems.name: status_id_closed
configurationItems.description: Splunk ES status ID to set for the TheHive 'Closed' stage. Default matches Splunk ES's factory 'Closed' status

configurationItems.name: sync_owner
configurationItems.description: Also set the notable event's owner (newOwner) to the case/alert's TheHive assignee. Off by default: TheHive logins and Splunk usernames are different identity spaces with no guaranteed mapping - only enable this once you've confirmed they line up (e.g. both are email addresses, or your Splunk usernames match TheHive logins).
